items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: The mention of 'Luch' appears exclusively in the [INTERVIEWER]'s turn ('Luch's mother's house there'). The [INTERVIEWEE] does not respond to or acknowledge this specific mention, nor does the interviewee mention Luch in the provided context.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. When we went over and played the cornerstone lane in the way, uh, uh, Luch's mother's house there. Yeah. In the Jack, Ron Jack, what's the name of that place? That was, uh, wait, no, that was, uh, Craig Church. Craig Church, yeah. Craig Church. In Algiers over there.
